info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Favorites-v1-spec
info.description: The List Pet Adoption Favorites API allows users to fetch a personalized list of their favorite pets available for adoption. This endpoint is designed for individuals looking to streamline their search by highlighting pets they are particularly interested in. Typical consumers include pet adoption organizations and users who are actively seeking to adopt pets. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance user experience by easily retrieving and displaying favorite pets for quicker decision-making.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of favorite pets.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch their favorite pets from the system. It returns a list of pets marked as favorites, which can help users easily access and manage their preferred animals.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the user's favorite pets. This should include the necessary data for identifying the user or context in which to fetch the favorite pets.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of favorite pets.
